chunks: 2555 - Durust narrated from Muḥammad ibn al-Faḍl al-Hāshimī, who said:
I entered with my brothers upon Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, and we said to him: “We intend hajj, and some of us are performing it for the first time.”

So he عليه السلام said: “You must observe tamattuʿ, for we do not practice taqiyyah with anyone concerning tamattuʿ by ʿumrah up to hajj, and [concerning] avoiding intoxicants and wiping over the khuffayn.”

key_terms.التَّمَتُّعِ: the tamattuʿ form of hajj, combining ʿumrah with hajj
key_terms.الْمَسْحِ عَلَى الْخُفَّيْنِ: wiping over leather socks instead of washing the feet in wudu (ablution)
key_terms.بِالْعُمْرَةِ: by means of ʿumrah, linked to the hajj rite here
key_terms.صَرُورَةٌ: one performing hajj for the first time

ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام instruct regarding tamattuʿ in hajj and wiping over the khuffayn?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal directive regarding the form of hajj to be performed, instructing the believers to perform tamattuʿ. It also places this ruling alongside two other identifiable legal markers: avoiding intoxicants and not wiping over the khuffayn. The report reflects a clear Imami legal stance taught by Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2555 - Durust narrated from Muhammad bin al-Fadl al-Hashimi, who said:
"I entered with my brothers upon Abu Abdullah (as) and said to him, 'We intend to perform Hajj, and some of us are performing it for the first time (ṣarūrah).'

Imam (as) said: 'You must perform Tamattu', for we do not fear anyone regarding Tamattu' [with Umrah joined to Hajj], and [you must also adhere to] avoiding intoxicants and the wiping over leather socks.'"
